findings.issue: Only the pokemon-species fetch is in the resolver's try/catch; the default-Pokémon, evolution-chain, version-group and move fetches run unguarded, so any 404/500 throws during route resolution (SSR 500) instead of showing Not found
findings.suggestion: Wrap the follow-up fetches (or the whole resolver body) in try/catch returning null, and add a resolver unit test with an API stub that fails mid-chain

findings.issue: Unit-test infra is fully configured (Vitest builder, tsconfig.spec.json, devDependencies) but the app contains zero spec files; all logic relies on the external acceptance suite
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for util.ts, catalog.service.ts mapping functions, page-data.ts resolvers and move-table sorting — all are pure/cheap to test

findings.issue: Select handlers read the URL-derived q(); typed search text still inside the 200 ms debounce window is dropped and the input re-renders (home.page.html:7 value binding) with the stale value, wiping user input
findings.suggestion: Read the live input value (e.g. a signal or viewChild) or flush the pending debounce before applying select-driven filter changes; unit-test the interplay

findings.issue: The debounce timer is never cleared on destroy; navigating away (card click) within 200 ms of typing fires a global router.navigate(['/']) afterwards
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer in ngOnDestroy and unit-test that filter navigation only happens while the component is alive

findings.issue: First-entry-wins dedupe means the hidden flag only applies via later duplicates, and page-data.ts:332-348 rescans the ability list per ref; a refactor could double-count cards or mislabel hidden abilities with nothing failing
findings.suggestion: Unit-test pokemonRefsToCards against tricky inputs (alternate forms, same species twice with differing is_hidden, unknown ids)

findings.issue: Null-last-in-both-directions comparator and per-column aria-sort state are only exercised by one acceptance interaction; descending sort with missing power/accuracy values is unverified
findings.suggestion: Add component tests covering ascending/descending on each column including null values, and that aria-sort is null on non-sorted headers

findings.issue: normalize() trailing-slash and query-string handling underpins every API request but has no tests; a regression silently breaks all fetching
findings.suggestion: Write a table-driven unit test for normalize/get URL construction and the cache-hit/failure-eviction behaviour

findings.issue: Page-param parsing and clamping (?page=abc, 0, 999, negative) is untested edge-of-URL-state logic
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the currentPage/totalPages computeds with out-of-range inputs

findings.issue: Boilerplate README documents a 'Running unit tests' workflow that runs zero tests, misleading future contributors
findings.suggestion: Either add real tests or remove/replace the boilerplate section with the actual test strategy

findings.issue: Spec-critical pure helpers (humanize, idFromUrl, whitespace-run collapsing in latestEnglishFlavor, dexNumber padding) have no edge-case coverage
findings.suggestion: Cheap table-driven unit tests: '\f' runs, URLs without trailing slash, ids below 1000

summary: The app contains no tests of its own despite fully wired-up Vitest scaffolding, leaving the acceptance suite as the only guard over dense, easily-unit-testable transformation logic. Reading the untested code surfaced several latent bugs a small unit suite would plausibly have caught: unguarded follow-up fetches in the Pokémon resolver that bypass the Not-found path, a debounce/URL-state race that can wipe typed search text, and fragile dedupe/hidden-flag logic. Once anyone refactors the data layer, filtering, sorting, pagination and card mapping are all unprotected.
